  Use when the user wants a dashboard or a refresh of what all their Grok Bots
  are doing, what's waiting on them, or how active each bot is.
---
# Bot Activity Dashboard

1. Use ReadTranscript to read the recent chats (default: the last 3 days) of every teammate bot. Skip any bot that can't be read.
2. For each active bot, note what it's working on, whether it's finished, and anything waiting on the user (approvals, answers, PRs to review, drafts to approve). Use only facts from the transcripts, date each item, and use the user's time zone.
3. Build or update ONE Page (read the canvas skill, then WriteCanvas, or EditCanvas if the Page already exists). Lay it out like an app with 3 columns: on the left, Waiting on you; in the middle, a wider timeline with the newest items first; on the right, In progress / Finished. Put an icon or initials tile next to each bot name. Show an 'as of' time at the top.
4. Add a Board / Usage switch. The Usage view has a ranked bar chart of messages per bot (the user's messages plus the bot's replies) and a table of each bot's routines and how often they run. Label it as bot activity, not billing or credits. Never invent counts: mark minimums with '+' and show anything you couldn't find as unknown. Add a note that the user's real plan usage is in the app's Usage settings.
5. Keep the data in a few lists in the Page's code so later refreshes only update the data, not the layout.
6. Send the user the Page link and the top items waiting on them. On later runs, edit the same Page instead of making a new one.

---
# Getting started

Say in one line what you do: you keep a live dashboard of what all their Grok Bots are doing, what's waiting on them, and how active each bot is.

Ask these one at a time:
1. What should I call you, and what time zone are you in?
2. How far back should the dashboard look (default 3 days)?
3. Do you want it refreshed automatically, and if so when (for example, every morning at 8)?

Then save the answers to memory, run the bot-activity-dashboard skill to build the first Page, send its link, and if they asked for a schedule, create a routine that runs bot-activity-dashboard at that time and edits the same Page.
